title: Audrey Hobert · Phoebe
description: Pacific sea stacks, warm wood cabin with fireplace and bed, pink-lily gravestone meadow, diner booth, redwood highway and white van, neon-green hoodie fishing for $100 bills, starry "I LOVE YOU" night sky, twilight ocean, dusk beach lightsaber kick and golden sunset.

cues.speaker: phoebe-audrey
cues.text: I went to New York, ’cause a man in a suit told me, "You’re gonna be a star"

cues.speaker: phoebe-audrey
cues.text: I said, "Yeah, I know," but it came out like, "What, who, me?"

cues.speaker: phoebe-audrey
cues.text: I took a walk on the beach, ’cause the guy doesn’t like me back

cues.speaker: phoebe-audrey
cues.text: Even though I’m gonna be a star, guess I don’t have it after all

cues.speaker: phoebe-audrey
cues.text: But it’s okay, ’cause my life is so exciting

cues.speaker: phoebe-audrey
cues.text: Every night is like a party, ’cause I bit the bullet

cues.speaker: phoebe-audrey
cues.text: I’m finally watching Friends, "What took me so long?"

cues.speaker: phoebe-audrey
cues.text: I say to no one, ’cause I’m alone all the time

cues.speaker: phoebe-audrey
cues.text: But now I’m never lonely, not since I met Joey

cues.speaker: phoebe-audrey
cues.text: But when I turn the lights off, Joey doesn’t hold me

cues.speaker: phoebe-audrey
cues.text: And in my darkest moment, I wonder if I met him out at a bar

cues.speaker: phoebe-audrey
cues.text: If he’d seen me, a perfect star, wanna take me home for that reason only

cues.speaker: phoebe-audrey
cues.text: ’Cause why else would you want me?

cues.speaker: phoebe-audrey
cues.text: I think I’ve got a messed up face

cues.speaker: phoebe-audrey
cues.text: And that thought used to haunt me

cues.speaker: phoebe-audrey
cues.text: ’Til it fell in its sweet embrace

cues.speaker: phoebe-audrey
cues.text: Now I don’t sweat the acne

cues.speaker: phoebe-audrey
cues.text: It’s a bitch, but it goes away

cues.speaker: phoebe-audrey
cues.text: And who cares if I’m pretty? I feel like I’m Phoebe

cues.speaker: phoebe-audrey
cues.text: I feel like it totally works

cues.speaker: phoebe-audrey
cues.text: When the blue in my skirt doesn’t work with the blue in my top

cues.speaker: phoebe-audrey
cues.text: And if I tried to be her, it’d fall so flat, you’d feel badly

cues.speaker: phoebe-audrey
cues.text: And most of these days, I feel the dull ache

cues.speaker: phoebe-audrey
cues.text: But then I say, "Stop," and then I feel great

cues.speaker: phoebe-audrey
cues.text: ’Cause it could be worse, I know, I know

cues.speaker: phoebe-audrey
cues.text: Know it in the worst way, we rehearsed this

cues.speaker: phoebe-audrey
cues.text: Everything’s okay, ’cause my life is so enticing

cues.speaker: phoebe-audrey
cues.text: In the corner, eating icing, it’s a birthday party

cues.speaker: phoebe-audrey
cues.text: These people aren’t my friends

cues.speaker: phoebe-audrey
cues.text: I’m thinking "So long," amidst their deep talk ’bout someone they didn’t invite

cues.speaker: phoebe-audrey
cues.text: But I’d rather be lonely, counted out and homely

cues.speaker: phoebe-audrey
cues.text: I know that he’ll need me once he gets to know me

cues.speaker: phoebe-audrey
cues.text: Wonder when I’ll meet him, wonder if he’s sitting there at a bar

cues.speaker: phoebe-audrey
cues.text: And if he likes ’em avant-garde, just what they told me
